what: Plan omits trap-safe error suppression on proposed PR_BODY_TMP rm inside wt_cleanup
scenario_or_breakage: Adjacent ENUM cleanup uses rm -f … 2>/dev/null || true (line 145); a bare [ -n … ] && rm -f "$PR_BODY_TMP" can return non-zero on permission or odd FS errors and, under set -e, abort wt_cleanup before worktree removal (lines 146-151)
suggested_fix: Mirror line 145: [ -n "${PR_BODY_TMP:-}" ] && rm -f "$PR_BODY_TMP" 2>/dev/null || true; optionally set PR_BODY_TMP="" after the explicit post-gh rm (ENUM_TOP_TMP="" pattern at line 287)
